fields.name: Health and medicine
fields.blurb: Caring for bodies and minds, from doctors to nurses to pharmacists.
fields.pick: Science with Biology (PCB) is the usual choice. Chemistry and Physics matter too.
fields.exams: NEET-UG (run by NTA) is the entrance test for MBBS, BDS, BAMS, BHMS, BUMS and BVSc. B.Sc Nursing seats are counselled by MCC for some institutions, but most nursing, pharmacy and physiotherapy admissions run through state routes that differ. Check the current rules for each.
fields.degree: MBBS takes 5.5 years including internship. BDS takes 5 years. B.Pharm and B.Sc Nursing take 4 years. Specialising means a postgraduate degree after that.
fields.early: Shadow a doctor, volunteer at a clinic, or take a first-aid course.
fields.note: Government medical seats are extremely competitive. Nursing, pharmacy, physiotherapy and other allied health courses are strong paths too.
verify: Nursing and physiotherapy admission routes vary and have been changing. Confirm with the state authority and the council.
Plan B routes are suggestions, not rules. Check each admission process on the official site.
fields.backup: If the NEET result does not go your way: allied health degrees (B.Sc Nursing, physiotherapy, pharmacy, medical laboratory or radiography technology), BAMS or BHMS through NEET, or a B.Sc in a life science with a later master's in public health or biotechnology.
fields.compare: Compare colleges with the official NIRF rankings (nirfindia.org, category: Medical, Dental or Pharmacy), and ask for last year's cut-offs and seat numbers.

fields.name: Science and research
fields.blurb: Finding out how nature and numbers work.
fields.pick: Science, with Maths or Biology depending on your subject.

subjects.cbse: English, then three of Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics, Biology.
subjects.isc: English, then three of Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics, Biology.
subjects.state: Science stream. Pick the mix that matches your favourite subject.

fields.exams: CUET-UG for BSc at central universities. IISER Aptitude Test (IAT) for IISERs. NEST for NISER and UM-DAE CEBS. Many universities run their own tests.
fields.degree: BSc (3 years) then MSc, or a 4-year BS, or a 5-year BS-MS. Research careers usually continue to a PhD.
fields.early: Join a science club or Olympiad, or try a small project of your own.
verify: Eligibility marks and years for IAT and NEST change every cycle. Read the current brochure.
Plan B routes are suggestions, not rules. Check each admission process on the official site.
fields.backup: If IISER or NISER is not possible: a B.Sc at a central or state university (often through CUET), then an M.Sc and NET or GATE for research.
fields.compare: Compare colleges with the official NIRF rankings (nirfindia.org, category: College or University), and ask for last year's cut-offs and seat numbers.

fields.name: Engineering
fields.blurb: Designing and building machines, structures and systems.
fields.pick: Science with Maths (PCM) is the usual choice.

subjects.cbse: English, Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics, and one more (Computer Science, Informatics Practices or Physical Education).
subjects.isc: English, Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics, and Computer Science if you like.

fields.exams: JEE Main for NITs, IIITs and many colleges, and JEE Advanced for the IITs. State entrance tests. Private tests such as BITSAT and VITEEE. For NITs and IIITs the NTA has asked for Physics and Maths plus one of Chemistry, Biology, Biotechnology or a technical vocational subject, with a minimum Class 12 mark or percentile.
fields.degree: B.Tech or BE (4 years): mechanical, civil, electrical, chemical, aerospace and more.
fields.early: Fix or build something. Join a robotics, design or EV club.
verify: JEE Main subject and marks rules change by year. Read the current Information Bulletin on jeemain.nta.nic.in.
Plan B routes are suggestions, not rules. Check each admission process on the official site.
fields.backup: If the JEE rank falls short: state engineering entrance tests, private universities through BITSAT, VITEEE or their own tests, or a 3-year diploma followed by lateral entry into the second year of B.Tech.
fields.compare: Compare colleges with the official NIRF rankings (nirfindia.org, category: Engineering), and ask for last year's cut-offs and seat numbers.

fields.name: Technology and data
fields.stream: Science with Maths (PCM) plus Computer Science
fields.blurb: Writing software, finding patterns in data, keeping systems safe.
fields.pick: Science with Maths (PCM) plus Computer Science is the usual choice.

subjects.cbse: English, Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics, and Computer Science or Informatics Practices.
subjects.isc: English, Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics, and Computer Science.
subjects.state: Science stream with Maths. Many states offer Computer Science as an option.

fields.exams: JEE Main and Advanced, state entrance tests, and private tests such as BITSAT and VITEEE. CUET-UG for BSc Computer Science. JEE Main subject and marks rules change by year.
fields.degree: B.Tech or BE (4 years) in computer science, AI and data science, or similar. Some online BS degrees accept students from other streams.
fields.early: Build small projects, try coding contests, join a coding or robotics club.
verify: Plan B routes are suggestions, not rules. Check each admission process on the official site.
fields.backup: If a computer science seat at a top college is out of reach: BCA then MCA, a B.Sc in computer science or data science, or a diploma with lateral entry into B.Tech. Real projects and certificates count for a lot in this field.
fields.compare: NIRF does not rank this area. Check the exam body or council for its list of approved institutions, and ask each institute for last year's cut-offs, seats and placement record.

fields.name: Business and finance
fields.stream: Commerce (add Maths for finance and economics)
fields.blurb: Money, markets, people and running businesses.
fields.pick: Commerce is the usual choice. Add Maths if you like finance, economics or data.

subjects.cbse: English, Accountancy, Business Studies, Economics, and Mathematics if you want finance or economics later.
subjects.isc: English, Accounts, Commerce or Business Studies, Economics. Mathematics is a strong add-on.
subjects.state: Commerce stream. Take Maths if your board offers it.

fields.exams: CUET-UG for BCom and BBA at central universities. IPMAT for the 5-year IPM at some IIMs. NPAT, SET and other private tests. CA Foundation from ICAI: provisional registration is possible after Class 10, and the exam is taken after Class 12.
fields.degree: BCom, BBA or BSc Economics (3 to 4 years). CA runs alongside: Foundation, Intermediate, Final and practical training. CFA, CMA and CS are other routes. An MBA often comes later.
fields.early: Run the budget for a school fest or a small stall.
verify: ICAI rules on registration timing and marks were reported differently by different sources. Check the ICAI portal.
Plan B routes are suggestions, not rules. Check each admission process on the official site.
fields.backup: If CA is not for you: B.Com with CMA, CS or CFA alongside, or BBA and an MBA later. Banking and other exams are open after any graduation.
fields.compare: Compare colleges with the official NIRF rankings (nirfindia.org, category: Management or College), and ask for last year's cut-offs and seat numbers.

fields.name: Design and creative arts
fields.stream: Any stream (Science with Physics and Maths for Architecture)
fields.blurb: Shaping how things look, feel and work.
fields.pick: Any stream works for most design courses. Architecture needs Physics and Maths plus one more subject from an approved list.

subjects.cbse: Any stream works for most design courses. Fine Arts or Informatics Practices can help. For Architecture take Physics and Mathematics plus one more subject from the Council of Architecture list (such as Chemistry, Biology, Computer Science, Informatics Practices or a vocational subject).
subjects.isc: Any stream works for most design courses. Art or Computer Science can help. For Architecture take Physics and Mathematics plus one more subject from the Council of Architecture list (such as Chemistry, Biology, Computer Science, Informatics Practices or a vocational subject).
subjects.state: Any stream for design. For Architecture take Physics and Maths plus one more subject from the approved list.

fields.exams: UCEED (IITs and a few others), NID DAT, NIFT entrance, and university tests. Architecture: NATA or JEE Main Paper 2. The Council of Architecture rule for Class 12 is Physics and Maths plus one more subject from a list, with 45% aggregate marks.
fields.degree: B.Des (4 years), B.Arch (5 years), BFA (3 to 4 years), or degrees in animation, film and fashion.
fields.early: Keep a sketchbook, redesign an app you use, build a small portfolio.
fields.note: A portfolio often matters as much as marks.
verify: The Council of Architecture changed the B.Arch Class 12 subject rule from Physics, Chemistry and Maths. Read the current NATA brochure.
Plan B routes are suggestions, not rules. Check each admission process on the official site.
fields.backup: If UCEED or NID is missed: other design schools with their own tests, a B.Des at a private university, or a degree in fine arts or architecture with a strong portfolio.
fields.compare: Compare colleges with the official NIRF rankings (nirfindia.org, category: Architecture and Planning or College), and ask for last year's cut-offs and seat numbers.

fields.name: Understanding people
fields.stream: Any stream (Humanities with Psychology is common)
fields.blurb: Helping people think, feel and grow.
fields.pick: Any stream works here. Humanities with Psychology is the most common choice.

subjects.cbse: English, Psychology, and two or three of Biology, Sociology, Political Science, Economics.
subjects.isc: English, Psychology, and two or three of Biology, Sociology, Political Science, Economics, Computer Science.
subjects.state: Humanities or Science (Biology). Psychology is offered in many state boards.

fields.exams: CUET-UG (Psychology) for central universities. Many private universities run their own tests.
fields.degree: BA or BSc Psychology (3 years), then MA or MSc (2 years). Clinical psychologists then need an RCI-recognised postgraduate clinical psychology qualification (RCI now lists the M.Clin.Psy and Psy.D, replacing the older M.Phil). School counsellors often add a B.Ed.
fields.early: Volunteer with a school counsellor, a clinic or an NGO.
verify: RCI changed its clinical psychology qualifications from 2024-25. Check the current RCI list before choosing a course.
Plan B routes are suggestions, not rules. Check each admission process on the official site.
fields.backup: If a psychology honours seat is hard to get: a BA in Psychology at any good college, then an MA or M.Sc and approved training if you want to practise as a clinical psychologist.
fields.compare: Compare colleges with the official NIRF rankings (nirfindia.org, category: College or University), and ask for last year's cut-offs and seat numbers.

fields.name: Law and justice
fields.pick: Any stream works. Humanities is the most common choice.

subjects.cbse: English plus subjects that build reading and argument: Political Science, History, Legal Studies, Economics.
subjects.isc: English plus Political Science, History, Legal Studies, Economics or Psychology.

fields.exams: CLAT for National Law Universities, AILET for NLU Delhi, and CUET and university tests for other law schools.
fields.degree: 5-year integrated BA LLB, BBA LLB or BCom LLB, or a 3-year LLB after any degree. Judicial services: the state judicial services exam after LLB, where the practice requirement has been changing. Check the notice for your state.
fields.early: Join debate or Model UN. Read a news story and argue both sides.
verify: In May 2025 the Supreme Court made 3 years of practice a condition for the Civil Judge exam. Law-news sites report a change in August 2026, with relief for notifications issued up to 31 March 2027. These are secondary reports. Read the judgment and your state High Court notice.
Plan B routes are suggestions, not rules. Check each admission process on the official site.
fields.backup: If CLAT or AILET does not work out: other law school tests (such as SLAT or state tests) or a 3-year LLB after any degree.
fields.compare: Compare colleges with the official NIRF rankings (nirfindia.org, category: Law), and ask for last year's cut-offs and seat numbers.

fields.name: Media, writing and teaching
fields.blurb: Telling stories, explaining ideas and teaching others.
fields.pick: Humanities is the usual choice, but any stream can lead here.

subjects.cbse: English, plus subjects you enjoy reading and writing about: English Literature, History, Political Science, Psychology, or a language.
subjects.isc: English Literature, plus History, Political Science, Psychology, Sociology or a language.
subjects.state: Humanities. Choose languages and social science subjects you enjoy.

fields.exams: CUET-UG for BA and journalism courses at central universities. Media schools such as IIMC run their own tests, mostly at postgraduate level. NCET for the 4-year ITEP teacher degree after Class 12. Teachers also pass TET or CTET.
fields.degree: BA or BJMC (3 years), then MA. B.Ed (2 years after a degree) or the 4-year ITEP.
fields.early: Write for the school magazine, start a small blog or podcast, or tutor younger students.
verify: Teacher-training rules have been changing. Check the current NCTE notice.
Plan B routes are suggestions, not rules. Check each admission process on the official site.
fields.backup: If IIMC is out of reach: a BA in journalism, English or mass communication at a university, plus a portfolio of writing, audio or video that you build yourself.
fields.compare: Compare colleges with the official NIRF rankings (nirfindia.org, category: College or University), and ask for last year's cut-offs and seat numbers.

fields.name: Public service and defence
fields.blurb: Running public systems and keeping people safe.
fields.pick: Any stream works. NDA after Class 12 has its own subject rules.

subjects.cbse: Any stream. Political Science, History, Geography and Economics help for civil services.
subjects.isc: Any stream. Political Science, History, Geography and Economics help for civil services.

fields.exams: UPSC Civil Services after any graduation degree. State public service exams. NDA (UPSC) right after Class 12: the Army wing accepts any stream, while the Air Force and Naval wings need Physics, Chemistry and Maths in Class 12 (UPSC 2026 notice). CDS after graduation. State police and SSC exams.
fields.degree: Any degree for civil services. Policy and planning paths: BA in Political Science, Economics or Geography, then MA or MPP. Urban planning has its own degree.
fields.early: Follow current affairs, join NCC or Model UN, or help with a local civic project.
verify: Check the current UPSC NDA notice for subjects, age and physical standards. Wings and schemes differ.
Plan B routes are suggestions, not rules. Check each admission process on the official site.
fields.backup: Civil services and defence exams can be tried more than once, and a degree in any subject keeps that door open. State public service and SSC exams are other routes.
fields.compare: Compare colleges with the official NIRF rankings (nirfindia.org, category: College or University), and ask for last year's cut-offs and seat numbers.

fields.name: Travel, hospitality and aviation
fields.stream: Any stream (Physics and Maths for pilot training)
fields.blurb: Flying, cooking, hosting and moving people around the world.
fields.pick: Most routes accept any stream. Pilot training currently asks for Physics and Maths.

subjects.cbse: Any stream for hospitality and cabin crew. For pilot training, Physics and Mathematics in Class 12.
subjects.isc: Any stream for hospitality and cabin crew. For pilot training, Physics and Mathematics in Class 12.
subjects.state: Any stream. For pilot training, Physics and Maths.

fields.exams: NCHM JEE for hospitality degrees at the Institutes of Hotel Management. Airlines and flying schools run their own selection. Pilot licence (DGCA): Class 12 with Physics and Maths from a recognised board, and a Class 1 medical.
fields.degree: BSc Hospitality (3 years), culinary diplomas and degrees, or a commercial pilot licence through a flying school.
fields.early: Cook for family events, plan a trip, or try a flying-club introductory session.
verify: DGCA asks for Physics and Maths. A 2025 proposal to relax this was reported but not confirmed. Whether NIOS certificates count was not confirmed. Check the current DGCA rule.
Plan B routes are suggestions, not rules. Check each admission process on the official site.
fields.backup: If the NCHM JEE is missed: private hotel management institutes or a BBA in hospitality. For airline roles, check each airline's rules and training.
fields.compare: NIRF does not rank this area. Check the exam body or council for its list of approved institutions, and ask each institute for last year's cut-offs, seats and placement record.

fields.name: Sports and fitness
fields.blurb: Competing, coaching and keeping others fit.
fields.pick: Any stream works. Keep your studies going alongside training.

subjects.cbse: Any stream. Physical Education is offered as an elective.
subjects.isc: Any stream. Physical Education is offered as an elective.
subjects.state: Any stream. Physical Education if offered.

fields.exams: Trials and sports-quota admissions. Entrance tests at sports universities and colleges. Coaching certificates from national sports institutes.
fields.degree: BSc Sports Science or BPEd (3 to 4 years), then coaching certificates. Many athletes study alongside training.
fields.early: Compete at school and district level, and train a younger team.
fields.note: Only a few become full-time athletes. Coaching, sports science and fitness careers are much more common.
verify: Course names and entrance tests vary widely between institutions. Confirm with the college.
Plan B routes are suggestions, not rules. Check each admission process on the official site.
fields.backup: If top sports institutes are out of reach: a B.P.Ed or a BA in physical education at a university, coaching certificates, or sports science courses.
fields.compare: NIRF does not rank this area. Check the exam body or council for its list of approved institutions, and ask each institute for last year's cut-offs, seats and placement record.

fields.name: Agriculture and environment
fields.blurb: Growing food, caring for land, water, forests and animals.
fields.pick: Science, with Biology or Maths. Agriculture is also an elective in some boards.

subjects.cbse: English, plus three of Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics, Biology, Agriculture (where offered).
subjects.isc: English, plus three of Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics, Biology.
subjects.state: Science stream, or Agriculture where your state board offers it.

fields.exams: CUET (ICAR-UG), run by NTA for ICAR, is the route into agriculture and allied degrees. Your CUET subjects must match your Class 12 subjects. State agricultural universities may run their own tests too.
fields.degree: BSc (Hons) in Agriculture, Horticulture, Forestry or Fisheries (4 years), or B.Tech in Agricultural Engineering or Food Technology. Veterinary: BVSc and AH through NEET-UG.
fields.early: Grow plants, join an eco club, or visit a farm or nursery.
verify: ICAR eligibility (subjects, marks, age) changes by year and by university. Read the current CUET (ICAR-UG) bulletin.
Plan B routes are suggestions, not rules. Check each admission process on the official site.
fields.backup: If ICAR-linked seats are missed: a B.Sc in botany, zoology or environmental science, or the admissions run by state agricultural universities.
fields.compare: Compare colleges with the official NIRF rankings (nirfindia.org, category: Agriculture and Allied Sectors), and ask for last year's cut-offs and seat numbers.

fields.name: Skilled trades and technical diplomas
fields.blurb: Hands-on technical careers through ITI and polytechnic routes.
fields.pick: This route can start after Class 10, so you do not have to pick a Class 11 stream first.

subjects.cbse: Optional on this route. Many students take Science or Commerce and move to an ITI or diploma later.
subjects.isc: Optional on this route. Many students take Science or Commerce and move to an ITI or diploma later.
subjects.state: Optional on this route. State boards often have vocational streams in Class 11 and 12.

fields.exams: ITI (NCVT trades) usually asks for Class 10, and a few trades Class 8 or Class 10 with Science and Maths. Polytechnic diplomas take students after Class 10 through state entrance tests or merit. Entry rules differ by state and institute.
fields.degree: ITI certificate (6 months to 2 years) or a 3-year diploma. Diploma holders can often join the second year of a B.Tech through lateral entry. Skilled trades lead to steady work or your own workshop.
fields.early: Fix a bicycle or a fan, try a school workshop, or visit an ITI open day.
fields.note: These careers are in demand, though pay varies a lot by place and employer, and they are often overlooked.
verify: ITI and polytechnic entry rules differ by state and institute.
Lateral entry to B.Tech was not checked on an official source here.
Plan B routes are suggestions, not rules. Check each admission process on the official site.
fields.backup: ITI and polytechnic diplomas are the direct way in. A diploma can lead to lateral entry into B.Tech later, and apprenticeship schemes often pay a stipend.
fields.compare: NIRF does not rank this area. Check the exam body or council for its list of approved institutions, and ask each institute for last year's cut-offs, seats and placement record.

fields.name: Performing arts and music
fields.blurb: Music, dance, acting, film and photography.
fields.pick: Any stream works. Keep training alongside your studies.

subjects.cbse: Any stream. Music, Dance or Fine Arts if your school offers them.
subjects.isc: Any stream. Music, Art or Drama if your school offers them.
subjects.state: Any stream. Arts electives if offered.

fields.exams: Colleges and universities hold auditions and entrance tests. CUET-UG includes performing arts subjects for some universities. Film and TV institutes run their own tests.
fields.degree: BA or BPA in music, dance or theatre (3 years), BFA, or film and media diplomas. Many performers earn alongside another skill, so a second skill helps.
fields.early: Perform at school events, learn an instrument, record a short reel.
fields.note: Only a few earn a full living from performing. Teaching, production and media jobs are more common.
verify: Course names and entrance tests vary a lot. Confirm with the college.
Plan B routes are suggestions, not rules. Check each admission process on the official site.
fields.backup: If a music, drama or film school place is missed: private institutes, a university BA in music or performing arts, and a performance or recording portfolio you build yourself.
fields.compare: NIRF does not rank this area. Check the exam body or council for its list of approved institutions, and ask each institute for last year's cut-offs, seats and placement record.

fields.name: Maritime and logistics
fields.blurb: Ships, ports and moving goods around the world.
fields.pick: Science with Maths (PCM) is the usual choice for sea careers.
fields.exams: IMU CET for Indian Maritime University degrees in nautical science and marine engineering. A medical fitness certificate from a doctor approved by DG Shipping is required.
fields.degree: B.Sc Nautical Science or B.Tech Marine Engineering (3 to 4 years), then sea service for licences. Shore jobs in shipping and logistics follow, and BBA or BCom in logistics is another route.
fields.early: Visit a port, learn to swim and sail, or build a ship model or navigation project.
verify: IMU rules (PCM marks, English marks, age, marital status) varied across pages and programmes. Read the current IMU notice.
Plan B routes are suggestions, not rules. Check each admission process on the official site.
fields.backup: If IMU CET is missed: other maritime institutes approved by the DG Shipping, or a nautical science degree at an approved college. Check the approval before you pay.
fields.compare: NIRF does not rank this area. Check the exam body or council for its list of approved institutions, and ask each institute for last year's cut-offs, seats and placement record.
